title: Remove Core's dead hooks, scripts, records and moot tasks
goal: Fourth round: what nothing uses leaves Core. The post-commit hooks only run two scripts no maintained program answers; eleven scripts run for nothing or only for their own tests; the earlier runtime's roadmap, verdicts, evidence, lanes, features, storage and baselines are read by nothing; twenty GMCP roadmap tasks describe a server that left.

reuse.searched: Removes files; builds nothing. Looked at what reads each: the hooks (.githooks), .cargo/config.toml, .config/nextest.toml, .gitattributes, rust-toolchain.toml, .gitignore, scripts/check-task-scope.sh, tests (architecture_tests, agent_bootstrap, hermetic_scope, sync_hooks, no_github_coupling, task_records), AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CONTRIBUTORS.md and docs/README.md.
